'''Mendan''' is an [[Aiel]] and a [[Siswai'aman]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mendan|Mendan}}  His clan, sept, and society are unknown.

==Apperance==
He is a large bulky man with startlingly blue eyes and axe-handle-wide shoulders.{{ref||Mendan}}

==Activities==
He is one of the Aiel who guards [[Verin Mathwin]] against anyone who might misunderstand her position in the [[Aiel]] camp.
